blurb: Caloosa River Inc. offers daily and multi-day boat rentals from 8 am to 5 pm. Boats come in various sizes and styles for cruising, fishing, or dolphin watching. Options include rentals with experienced captains or self-drive boats.
extraNote: Failure to cancel in a timely manner will result in responsibility for half of the reservation rate. · Bad Weather: Caloosa River Inc. reserves the right to cancel at any time due to foul or inclement weather, such as any weather that may be dangerous to your average boater. · Automatic cancellation applies for small craft advisories or high threat of severe weather for coastal waters (not the Gulf of Mexico). · You can reschedule or cancel with no fee.
cancellation: Our cancellation policy does not permit cancellations via text message or email. Please be aware of this when requesting a cancellation. You must call 239-691-4099 within 24 hours for single weekday reservations. Holidays and weekends require at least 48 hours’ notice. For multi-day reservations, you must provide notice 5 days in advance of the pickup day.
